meta.source: Renewables.ninja, calendar year 2023. PV: MERRA-2, 10% system loss, tilt=|latitude|, equator-facing (azim=180). Wind: MERRA-2, Vestas V90 2000 at 80 m. Both from the same reanalysis and same year, so wind/solar correlation holds.
meta.coords: Capacity-weighted centroids of real REIPPPP plants where they exist (from PyPSA-RSA plant data); representative points elsewhere - see FALLBACK entries in fetch_real_regional_profiles.py, the weakest assumption here.
meta.solar_source_pvgis: PVGIS SARAH2 (0.05° × 0.05° satellite, 5 km resolution), year 2019, tilt=|latitude|, equator-facing (aspect=0), 10% system losses. Replaces MERRA-2 solar profiles (0.5° × 0.5°, 50 km) which compressed the regional spread to 1.08× max/min; real SA solar resource has ~1.4-1.5× spread between Northern Cape (best) and KwaZulu-Natal (coastal cloud/humidity). Coordinates are capacity-weighted centroids of real REIPPPP plants where they exist.
